prompt: A fund has monthly return volatility of 4.30%, an R-squared of 0.99 against its benchmark, and an 0.85% expense ratio; a comparable index fund charges 0.05%. Compute the annualized tracking error and the breakeven information ratio, and tell me whether this looks like a closet indexer.

assertions.text: Identifies a closet index fund given high R-squared and low tracking error
